title: Macro-bearing URL
description: Backward-compatible URL value that preserves the existing uri-template branch (including deep links, protocol-relative references, and RFC 6570 host variables) while additionally accepting absolute HTTP(S) URLs with byte-preserved ad-server macro delimiters, including %%...%%, [...] and ${...}. This schema accepts macro spellings without assigning substitution semantics; the existing format and integration contracts determine how they are resolved.
